content: Loading ABBA atlas ROIs in QuPath via Groovy: qupath.ext.biop.abba.AtlasTools.loadWarpedAtlasAnnotations(getCurrentImageData(), 'acronym', false). Third parameter controls hemisphere split. This reads the ABBA-RoiSet-*.zip and ABBA-Transform-*.json from the entry directory and creates annotation objects in the image hierarchy with atlas region names. Must be run before detection so that BraiAnDetect assigns detections to named regions. Can be scripted and run via 'Run for project' to load ROIs for all entries in batch.
